rows.note: Use this written noun for the abstract quality of being shy or timid; casual speech usually describes the person rather than naming the quality.

example.english: Their timidity keeps them from speaking in crowded settings.
example.traditional: 佢嘅羞怯，令佢喺人多嘅場合唔敢發言。
